_comment: The expert roster. Two people, TWO DIFFERENT EVIDENTIARY REGIMES. They are kept separate on purpose: merging them would weaken the clinical one.

experts.name: Timur Alptunaer, MD
experts.domain: sauna, heat therapy, cold exposure, recovery, safety
experts.note: EVERY claim in claims.json is attributable to this expert ONLY. Enforced in code by assert_clinical_attribution(). Attribution of the BYLINE is separately enforced by assert_attribution_safe().

attribution.required_credential_line: Timur Alptunaer, MD, RN, EMT-T, FACEP
attribution.rule: His name must NEVER appear attached to a specialty he does not hold. The guard blocks the DESCRIPTION, not the subject matter: a pitch on dermatology is fine, 'Dr. Alptunaer, a dermatologist' is not, and neither is any phrasing a journalist could compress into one — 'skin expert', 'sleep specialist', 'specialist in X' for any X.
attribution.scope_vs_eligibility: Specialty governs how he is DESCRIBED, not what he can discuss. He is willing to speak outside his clinical practice; the condition is that the byline must not misrepresent him.

experts.credential_line: Timur Alptunaer, MD, RN, EMT-T, FACEP
experts.credential_line_note: VERBATIM LITERAL. Never reconstruct, abbreviate, reorder or expand it. Every pitchable item carries this exact string; assert_pitchable() requires an exact match and there is deliberately no code path that assembles it from parts.

observations_for_human.text: EMT-T is tactical EMT, which is directly relevant to the military and sports-performance topics in the experience set. This is RECORDED, NOT ACTED ON: nothing widens scope automatically, and no filter term was added from it. A human decides whether it changes what he is offered for.

experts.name: Tripler
experts.credentials: Certified health coach; MSc Organizational Behavior
experts.note: Experience-based. Deliberately has NO claims.json equivalent — the regimes differ and merging them would dilute the clinical standard. Topics below are PROVISIONAL and for measurement only; nothing may be pitched from them.

clinical_attribution_rule: A claim drawn from data/claims.json may be attributed to 'alptunaer' and to no one else. A health coach quoted on cardiovascular mortality literature is a scope-of-practice failure, and 'functional health' is precisely the boundary where that mistake happens. assert_clinical_attribution() raises rather than warns.
